visa-preparation.entry_summary: Australia isn't on the 15-day visa-exempt list (CPLP, EU, UK, US, Canada and named countries) as read; a visa is likely needed unless you hold a valid Schengen or US visa.

steps.step: Apply online at e-VisaST in three steps: choose the visa type, fill in the form, review and submit. Keep the process (reference) number it gives you.
Expect an answer within 7 working days; check its status on the SMF site under Autorização de entrada, then Consulta de visto de entrada.
Pay the visa fee at the border, and be ready to show proof of means of support (EUR 100 a day as published).

documents: Passport valid more than 3 months beyond the last day of stay on the visa (scanned as PDF for the application)
Booking details and a contact in São Tomé and Príncipe (your hotel if you have no other)
Proof of means of support at the border
For a minor: birth record and a declaration from the legal guardians
